Perps Changelog
Recent changes to the Polymarket Perps API and platform
Nov 19, 2026
Stale-price portfolio values, isolated withdrawals, and ANT, INTC, and SNDK tick changes
No endpoints or required request fields are removed. Check portfolio values during price outages and size parsing before the deploy. ANT, INTC, and SNDK change tick size, and SNDK splits 8-for-1.
Market Maintenance
ANT and INTC tick size. During the maintenance window, both markets move to 3 quantity decimals and 3 price decimals: a 0.001 size step and a 0.001 price tick.
Each market pauses, and all of its orders, TP/SL orders, and algos are canceled.
Positions are rounded toward zero to the new 0.001 size step. Any remainder below 0.001 is closed to the insurance fund, so reconcile your positions before quoting again.
SNDK 8-for-1 split. Trading pauses Thursday, November 19 at 7:55 PM ET (00:55 UTC Friday) and resumes Friday, November 20 at 8:00 AM ET (13:00 UTC), with the same post-only reopening. Prices and sizes convert 8-for-1, and SNDK moves to the 0.001 tick and size step at the same time. share_unit_version increments for SNDK, as in earlier splits.
Rollout
Maintenance starts Thursday, November 19 at 6:00 AM ET (11:00 UTC) and is expected to take 30–45 minutes. The exchange is cancel-only during the upgrade: cancels keep working, new orders are rejected, and resting orders stay on the book. ANT and INTC change tick size in the same window.
Nov 13, 2026
Price precision, public leverage, and capabilities
Clarified
Stock splits. ANT-USD can now go through a stock split to move to per-share units. Nothing happens on deploy; the pause and conversion will be announced separately. After it reopens, refresh its prices and sizes and recreate quotes canceled with stock_split.
Nov 10, 2026
Reduce-only closes, tiered maintenance, and cancel-on-disconnect
